snippet.title: LifePaths - Official Trailer | Dystopian Life Simulator
snippet.description:
The year is 2076.

Your life no longer entirely belongs to you.
Make your choices. Build relationships. Face the consequences.

Full Game on : https://lifepaths.io
Demo available on itch.io : https://lifepaths.itch.io/lifepaths-free-browser-demo
